context: Hiroshi visits Kenji as company president ten years later.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 健次、会社、立派になった。
lines.en: Kenji — the company has grown splendid under your work.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate praise. Opens with the name like an acknowledgment of presence. Warm beneath the formality. Voice settles on the core compliment with quiet confidence—not effusive, but unmistakably genuine.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 部長のお陰、本当に、感謝。
lines.en: It's only because of you, sir. I'm truly grateful.
lines.style: Respectful but not stiff. A moment's hesitation before 'grateful'—not doubt, but the weight of actually meaning it. Quieter than the boss, but direct. The warmth of someone who doesn't take kindness lightly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Direct hit of affirmation. The name lands with gentleness this time. Not many words—each one carries weight. A rare moment of the boss stepping slightly closer in tone, still composed but the tenderness audible.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 一緒に、ここまで、来た、本当に。
lines.en: We got here together, sir. Really.
lines.style: Soft and reflective. The word 'together' carries the weight of what they've built. Voice quiets on the trailing 'really'—not doubt, but something like awe at the fact of it. The sincerity of someone still processing gratitude.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: You're someone I've come to treasure, truly.
lines.style: Quiet, almost intimate despite the formality. The word 'treasure' lands with care. Composed as always, but there's something almost paternal in the deliberation—a rare moment of the boss letting sincerity show without defense.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 頑張ります、これからも。
lines.en: I'll keep giving my best going forward.
lines.style: Resolute but not boastful. A slight formal lift at the commitment. The tone of someone standing a little straighter, meeting the moment. Warmth wrapped in professionalism—the respectful answer to an elder's faith.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: I'll be cheering for you always.
lines.style: Low and even, almost solemn in its sincerity. The word 'always' lands with quiet promise. No flourish, no performance—just a composed man saying something he means to keep. The voice of someone who doesn't make promises lightly.
